note: Research 12/10 2026 af agenter med websøgning (FotMob, ESPN, ligaernes og klubbernes sider, Wikipedia m.fl.). Udvalgte, kendte hold, ikke hele ligaen. Startopstilling = seneste ligakamp før 12/10 eller holdets mest brugte startere (se lineupBasis/uncertain). Taktiktallene 1-5 er skøn; setAtt/setDef er for de fleste hold pladsholdere ('mix'/'mixed').

players.name: Ederson
players.attrWhy: Ex-City, 33; elite distribution, shot-stopping now good rather than top

players.name: Semedo
players.attrWhy: 32, ex-Barça/Wolves; still quick on the overlap, defensively solid

players.name: Škriniar
players.attrWhy: Ex-Inter/PSG, 31; strong in duels and marking, key in build-up (~63 accurate passes/90)

players.name: Aké
players.attrWhy: Ex-City Netherlands international, 31; tidy left-footer, reads the game well

players.name: Brown
players.attrWhy: Archie Brown; attacking LB, 5 goals for Fener, quick and direct

players.name: Kanté
players.attrWhy: 35; still a top ball-winner with huge stamina, short so weaker in the air

players.name: Guendouzi
players.attrWhy: €28m France international; box-to-box engine who can pass and carry

players.name: Greenwood
players.attrWhy: €39m from Marseille; two-footed, elite shot quality, 20+ goal seasons in Ligue 1

players.name: Asensio
players.attrWhy: 30, ex-Real Madrid; excellent left foot and passing, 13 goals for Fener, lost some pace

players.name: Kerem
players.attrWhy: Kerem Aktürkoğlu; Turkey international, ex-Benfica, 15 goals for Fener, works hard

players.name: Muriqi
players.attrWhy: 32; one of Europe's strongest target men in the air, prolific at Mallorca, 6 league goals this season

clubs.tacticsWhy: There is little hard data. 19 goals in 7 league matches (8-0 vs Eyüpspor, 4-2 vs Konyaspor) and an attacking front four (Greenwood, Asensio, Kerem, Muriqi) justify style off. FotMob player stats: Škriniar 63.5 accurate passes/90 (build-up from the back) and Guendouzi 3.6 long balls/90 (moderate), so passing 3. In the Rizespor match Sporx shows 50/50 possession and 8 shots to Rizespor's 14 (possibly placeholder data), so no evidence of extreme dominance. No PPDA, line-height or crossing data found, so press, line, tempo and width are kept neutral (3). setAtt/setDef are placeholders (no source).
clubs.desc: Fenerbahçe bygger op med en solid dobbelt-sekser og angriber med tekniske offensive spillere bag en målfarlig angriber.
uncertain: The 10 Oct XI comes from one lineup source (mylineups). It fits Sporx's substitution list (Greenwood, Muriqi, Guendouzi, Kerem replaced) and Wikipedia's squad numbers. The same back six plus Greenwood and Muriqi started vs Beşiktaş (5 Sep) and Eyüpspor (20 Sep). Lukaku started at Gaziantep (4-3-3, 14 Sep).
Greenwood RW / Kerem LW, Kanté RDM / Guendouzi LDM and Škriniar RCB / Aké LCB are inferred from listing order.
mylineups lists the score as 'Fenerbahçe 3–0 Rizespor', but Wikipedia and Sporx have Fenerbahçe away at Rize; I used (A). Sporx's possession figure (50/50) may be a placeholder.

Kit: Wikipedia only says the home kit is the striped 'Çubuklu' (yellow/navy; I used yellow #FFED00, navy is about #002A5C). The away colour was not found, so #FFFFFF is a placeholder guess. The kit section's citation is dated 2025, so it may be copied from last season.
Kartal's appointment: Wikipedia gives 18 June 2026 (one-year contract) in the text but 21 July 2026 in the stats table. No team-level tactical stats found; setAtt/setDef are placeholders.

clubs.lineupBasis: Most frequent league starters 2026/27 (all 7 league matches, every one 4-2-3-1); not the XI of the latest league match 2026-10-09 vs Kasımpaşa (H), where Osimhen and Sallai were benched on return from injury and Barış Alper played as stand-in right-back

players.name: Uğurcan
players.attrWhy: Uğurcan Çakır; €27.5m Turkey international, strong shot-stopper, average with the ball

players.name: Sallai
players.attrWhy: Hungarian winger converted to RB; hardworking and quick, adequate defender

players.name: Sánchez
players.attrWhy: Davinson Sánchez; fast, powerful CB, occasional lapses

players.name: Abdülkerim
players.attrWhy: Abdülkerim Bardakcı; captain, left-footed Turkey international, good organiser

players.name: Jakobs
players.attrWhy: Senegal LB; very quick overlapper, fair defender

players.name: Torreira
players.attrWhy: Combative Uruguayan screener and tidy passer; aggressive (red card vs Kasımpaşa)

players.name: Sara
players.attrWhy: Gabriel Sara; €18m creative deep-lying no.8, set-piece taker, shoots from range

players.name: Barış Alper
players.attrWhy: Barış Alper Yılmaz; powerful, quick Turkey international, also covers RB

players.name: Yunus
players.attrWhy: Yunus Akgün; nimble left-footed creator, good dribbles and assists, light frame

players.name: Leão
players.attrWhy: Rafael Leão; €38m from Milan, among Europe's fastest carriers, inconsistent finisher, does little defending

players.name: Osimhen
players.attrWhy: Victor Osimhen; elite runner in behind and in the air, 6 goals already, back from injury

clubs.tacticsWhy: Against Kasımpaşa (Sporx): 64% possession, 17 shots (11 on target), so a dominant style (off). Anadolu Ajansı's report says attacks came mostly down the flanks and many chances came from crosses and set pieces, so width 4. The assistant coach named pressing as part of the plan; with that much possession, press 4 and line 4 are estimates. The 4-2-3-1 is used in every league match, with direct wingers (Leão, Barış Alper) and a runner in behind (Osimhen), so tempo 4. Passing 3 because no long-ball data was found. No PPDA or line-height stats found. setAtt/setDef are placeholders (no source).
clubs.desc: Galatasaray har meget af bolden, angriber primært via kanterne med hurtige fløjspillere og indlæg og har en farlig angriber i dybden.
uncertain: Start counts from 7 league lineups (mylineups, checked against club and Turkish media): Sánchez, Torreira, Sara, Yunus 7; Uğurcan, Sallai, Abdülkerim, Jakobs 6; Barış Alper 5; Osimhen 4; Leão, Sané, Deniz Gül, Lemina 3. Leão beat Sané for the last place on recency (Leão started the last 3; Sané 1 of the last 3). With Sané instead, the XI is exactly the 2026-08-14 vs Çorum (H) lineup.
This exact XI has never started a league match together: Leão only started (from 13 Sep) while Osimhen was injured. Osimhen came on in the 77th minute vs Kasımpaşa and is described as fully fit.
Barış Alper RW, Yunus CAM, Leão LW follows the 13 Sep vs Kocaelispor shape. Yunus has also played RW and Barış Alper LW or RB. Torreira RDM / Sara LDM is inferred from listing order.
Matchday 3 (vs Göztepe): mylineups lists Jankat Yılmaz in goal, Politikam lists Uğurcan.

Home shirt: the 2026/27 design was not described in any source I could read, and the Wikipedia infobox base colour (270e8b) looks unreliable. I used Galatasaray red (#A90432); the other traditional colour is yellow (#FDB912). Away black (#000000) is from the Wikipedia infobox base colour. Buruk was suspended for the Kasımpaşa match (assistant İrfan Saraloğlu on the bench) but remains head coach.
